title: Brand family / Sub-brands / Gray variant
slide_intent: Make family structure recognizable without relying on color because a shared naming layout must work in neutral settings.
strategic_value: A common gray signature and descriptor arrangement can connect Duolingo initiatives without separate identity rules.
demonstration: The gray Duolingo wordmark and lighter-weight sub-brand descriptor form a horizontal lockup on a pale field.
practical_value: Use the generic family arrangement only for initiatives without their own rules.
